# Overhauled.ai

> Websites for trades and service businesses.

Overhauled.ai is a web design studio run by Mark Hurson, based in Guelph, Ontario, Canada. We build websites for trades and service business owners — plumbers, roofers, contractors, landscapers, cleaners and other local service companies — that rank on Google and turn searches into calls, at one flat price with no monthly fees.

## What We Do

One offer: a **Website Build** for trade and service businesses, **from $1,500 CAD, one-time**, with no monthly fees. It includes a fast, mobile-first site with a page for every service and service area, Google Business Profile setup, quote forms and calls routed to the owner's phone, a review request system, and the domain, hosting and phone set up in the client's own accounts.

## Who We Serve

Trades and service businesses: plumbers, electricians, HVAC, roofers, contractors and renovators, landscapers, cleaners, movers, junk removal, restoration and other companies that win work from people searching Google for help nearby. Based in Guelph, serving Waterloo Region, Wellington County and beyond.

## Pricing

- Website Build: from $1,500 CAD, one-time, flat quote before work begins, no monthly fees

## Recent Client Work

- **JD Home Solutions** (jdhomesolutions.ca) — Lawn care, window cleaning and permanent lighting in Barrie and Simcoe County; website plus managed Google Business Profile
